<!--
The most useful thing you can write here is the PROBLEM, not the solution.

"I have to type each item twice when a customer returns half an order" tells us
far more than "add a split-return button" - and often has a better answer than
the one you had in mind.
-->

## What are you trying to do?

<!-- The real situation in the shop. What happens, and when. -->

## What do you do today?

<!-- The workaround, however awkward. This tells us how much it actually hurts,
     and sometimes there is already a way we can point you at. -->

## Who else needs this?

<!-- A feature for one shop is a custom build or a fork. A feature for many
     shops is a feature. If you know others hitting this, say so. -->

## What would good look like?

<!-- Optional. If you have a shape in mind, describe it - but the problem above
     matters more. -->

## Acceptance criteria

<!--
What must be true before this issue can be closed? Keep these specific and
testable. A maintainer may edit this into smaller PR-sized steps before code
starts.
-->

- [ ] The user can...
- [ ] The app still...
- [ ] Tests or evidence prove...
- [ ] Documentation or operator wording explains...

## Does it need an internet connection?

<!-- The local edition must work fully offline. Anything that needs a
     connection belongs in Posnic Cloud rather than here. -->

- [ ] It works entirely offline
- [ ] It needs a connection

## Anything else

<!-- Screenshots, how other software does it, examples. -->
